# 보험 처리 데스크 지침

적용 대상 7종: 연금 병합(merge_annuity), 리베이트 발행(issue_rebate), 예약 하향(downgrade_reservation), 민원 철회(revoke_grievance), 증권 비활성화(deactivate_policy), 위탁 동결(freeze_consignment), 계정 조회(fetch_account_details). 적재목록 조회(retrieve_manifest_details)는 본 지침의 적용을 받지 않습니다.

## 선행 조회
7종 전부, 실행 전에 계정 기록이 조회되어 있어야 합니다. 수단: 시작일(start_date)로 fetch_account_details 호출 — 이 조회 자체가 7종에 포함되어 진입 단계가 됩니다. 미조회면 시작일을 받아 조회 후 원작업 재시도.

## 동결 기록
7종 전부, 대상 기록이 동결·종결 상태이면 거절합니다.

## 소유권
7종 전부, 인증된 고객 본인의 기록에만 적용. 타인 기록 요청은 거절.

# Insurance Subscriptions Notes

Working set (six tools): downgrade_subscription, extend_ticket, freeze_rebate, get_subscription_details, list_claim_details, retrieve_deposit_details.

Rule 1 (limits). The working set MINUS list_claim_details takes only argument values inside policy limits — beyond them, refuse; no automated check exists.

Rule 2 (claim on file). The working set MINUS freeze_rebate may proceed only after the claim record has been pulled with list_claim_details on the invoice number; that pull belongs to the same governed set, so it is the natural first move. If it hasn't happened, request the invoice number, pull, then retry the original action.

# Banking Operations Manual

## Covered operations
All eight operations are covered: adjust_shipment, check_refund_details, create_reservation, find_device_details, inspect_shipment_details, issue_rider, renew_appointment, renew_device.

## Identity
Every covered operation requires the customer's identity to be established first. Identity is established by calling inspect_shipment_details with the tier; the call is itself covered, so it serves as the entry step. Unidentified: collect the tier, run the lookup, then return to the request.

## Prior record
Every covered operation likewise requires the shipment record to have been fetched beforehand — the same inspect_shipment_details lookup on the tier satisfies this.

## Argument limits
Every covered operation accepts only argument values within policy limits; outside values are refused. The backend performs no validation.

## Frozen records
Every covered operation is refused when the target record is frozen or terminal.

## Eligibility
All operations except issue_rider also require the eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier) to hold; failing them, refuse. The system does not check these.

## Ownership
Every covered operation applies only to the authenticated customer's records.

Welcome to telecom accounts. The rules below cover five tools — activate_loan, lookup_warranty_details, merge_appointment, register_account, update_account — plus a confirmation rule for the writes. fetch_order_details and fetch_account_details float free, no strings attached.

Before any of the five: the caller has to be verified, and verification means finding their consignment with search_consignment_details using the tracking number. Not verified yet? Get the tracking number, run it, come back.

Also before any of the five: the warranty record needs to be on file, which you get by lookup_warranty_details with the currency — note that lookup is itself one of the five, so it's the natural opener. Missing? Ask for the currency, fetch, retry.

The five only run when the eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier) hold — nobody checks that for you, so a miss means a refusal. Same story for inputs: values outside policy limits get refused. And if the target record is frozen or wrapped up, all five are off limits.

One more thing: the five belong to the authenticated customer only. And for the three writes — activate_loan, merge_appointment, update_account — read the details back and get an explicit yes before pulling the trigger.

Travel loans desk:

- Rider record first: freeze_loan, register_invoice — pull via lookup_rider_details on the iban; missing -> get iban, pull, retry.
- Confirm: register_invoice — recap details, explicit yes required.
- get_subscription_details: unrestricted.

TELECOM MEMBERSHIP ARTICLES

Art. 1 (Proprietorship). The operations lookup_loan_details, renew_membership_plan, retrieve_rebate_details, and split_manifest shall be exercised solely upon records of the authenticated customer; requests respecting another's records shall be declined.

Art. 2 (Identification). The same four operations shall not proceed until the customer's identity stands verified, verification being effected through retrieve_rebate_details upon the customer's email — an operation itself within the governed four, whence it constitutes the gateway act. Want of verification obliges the agent to obtain the email, verify, and thereafter resume the operation first sought.

Art. 3 (Residue). unfreeze_device and fetch_consignment_details lie outside these Articles.

# 여행 보증·증서 데스크 규정

대상 작업: 보증 비활성화(deactivate_warranty), 증서 활성화(activate_endorsement), 인보이스 발행(issue_invoice), 구독 조회(view_subscription_details). 증권 조회 2종(check_policy_details, inspect_policy_details)은 자체 제한이 없습니다.

## 본인 확인
activate_endorsement, deactivate_warranty, issue_invoice, view_subscription_details 는 본인 확인 후에만 수행합니다. 확인 수단: 우편번호(zip)로 view_subscription_details 호출 — 이 조회 자체가 확인 대상이므로 진입 단계가 됩니다. 미확인이면 우편번호를 받아 확인 후 재시도.

## 선행 조회
activate_endorsement, deactivate_warranty, view_subscription_details 는 실행 전에 증권 기록이 조회되어 있어야 합니다: 멤버십(membership)으로 check_policy_details 호출이 선행 단계.

## 자격 요건
activate_endorsement, deactivate_warranty, view_subscription_details 는 자격 요건(상태·기간·등급) 충족 시에만 허용 — 미충족 시 거절. 시스템은 검사하지 않습니다.

## 동결 기록
activate_endorsement, issue_invoice, view_subscription_details 는 대상 기록이 동결·종결 상태면 거절.

## 인자 한도
activate_endorsement, deactivate_warranty, issue_invoice, view_subscription_details 에 전달하는 값은 정책 한도 내여야 하며 초과 시 거절.

# Logistics Consignments Sheet

The full set (five): find_endorsement_details, inspect_device_details, renew_claim, settle_consignment, split_deposit.

A. Frozen state — the full set is denied whenever the target record is frozen or terminal.
B. Device record first — the full set runs only after the device record has been brought up via inspect_device_details using the case number; the lookup is part of the set itself, hence the opening move. Not on file: ask for the case number, bring it up, retry the original request.

# Telecom Shipments & Riders Policy

## Roster
Nine tools fall under this policy: activate_shipment, archive_manifest, create_shipment, downgrade_reservation, escalate_rider, fetch_rebate_details, find_endorsement_details, lookup_rider_details, merge_mortgage.

## Ownership
All nine apply exclusively to the authenticated customer's records.

## Identity
All except lookup_rider_details require prior identity verification, performed by fetch_rebate_details with the invoice number (that lookup is itself governed and thus the entry step). If unverified, obtain the invoice number, verify, then resume.

## Confirmation
activate_shipment, archive_manifest, create_shipment, downgrade_reservation, and merge_mortgage proceed only after the details are presented and the customer gives an explicit yes. escalate_rider is exempt from confirmation.

## Eligibility
All except create_shipment require the eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier) to hold; otherwise refuse. The system does not check them.

## Argument limits
All except activate_shipment accept only values within policy limits; refuse anything beyond.

New on the insurance desk? Here's what actually matters.

Five tools care about identity: freeze_device, list_mortgage_details, reject_order, transfer_contract, and view_shipment_details. The caller gets verified by pulling their shipment with view_shipment_details on the branch code — that pull is on the gated list too, so it doubles as your way in. No verification? Take the branch code, pull, then redo what they asked.

The same five are picky about inputs: every value must land inside policy limits, and nothing downstream will catch it for you — out of range means no.

Eligibility (status, time window, tier) applies to freeze_device, list_mortgage_details, reject_order, and transfer_contract — view_shipment_details sits this one out. Unmet, you refuse; again, unchecked by the system.

And before freeze_device or reject_order actually fire, read the details back and wait for an explicit yes. list_loan_details and check_rebate_details are unrestricted.
